$doc: Fixed sizes: control heights, icons, avatars, hairlines and the widths floating things cap at. Not for spacing (that is space.json). bar and bar-compact are a bar's one-line height (design/layout.md §2): a bar never grows taller. v1's frame sizes (packages/ui/src/app): icon-tile 17 (Stuff, a setup tip's badge icon, a phone action), pill-row 19 (a row's pills), time-row 21 (a row's time), chip-lg 27 (the prompt box's project chips), pip 28 (the rail's pick), new-task 38, home-foot 48, action-tile 52 (a phone action), later-offset 68 (Save for later beside Mark done), title-reserve 92 (a row's title end while its quick buttons show), meta-min 100, home-top 140, pick-max 150, details 232 (the task's details column), read 760 (Home's column). And the in-between steps v1 uses in those places (v1-nudge 3, v1-snug 5, v1-tight 7, v1-grip 7.5, v1-indent 10.5): kept as they are, not rounded to the spacing scale (design/foundation.md §2). task-head 60 (an open task's head).
